components.description: Application shell: a Sidebar plus a main column. The frame measures its own width, so the same markup works on a phone, in a narrow window and in a Studio device preview. Pass routeKey={usePathname()} (or your router's equivalent) so the drawer closes after navigation. Put <SidebarTrigger /> in the TopBar. Do not hand-write hidden md:block / md:hidden wrappers, a hamburger IconButton, a navOpen state or a second Drawer copy of the navigation.
Inside the main column, size content with Grid columns="auto" and Flex wrap so it reflows when the sidebar opens, collapses or becomes a drawer.

Both follow the frame width and compactBelow, never the window, so they stay right in a narrow panel or a Studio preview. Do not use md:hidden or hidden md:block inside an AppFrame.
Do not use AppFrame for marketing pages or simple single-column sites.
